summary: Full verification of iteration 14 (Turkish LMS consulting fixes). Backend pytest 3/3 pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration14.py: (1) mark-paid BUG FIX — creating a pending kind=group order (item course_id='') and a pending kind=consulting order (item course_id='') and calling POST /api/admin/payments/{oid}/mark-paid as admin no longer creates any db.enrollments row with course_id=''; group order creates a group_enrollments row; consulting summary granted increases by exactly +1 (from the paid kind=consulting order itself, not from an erroneous enrollment) and available_credits by +1. A subsequent COURSE order mark-paid DOES create the enrollments row and granted becomes base+2 as expected. (2) POST /api/admin/consulting/bookings/{id}/meet returns 400 while the booking is pending and 200 after approve; GET /api/consulting/summary (as owning student) then returns the booking with meet_link=https://meet.google.com/xyz-abcd-efg and status=approved. Email template 'consulting_meet' exists in db.email_templates. (3) Reschedule flow: admin POST /propose sets status=rescheduled and stores proposed_date/proposed_time; student POST /respond {action:'accept'} sets status=approved with date/time = proposed values (proposed_* cleared) and the booking appears in GET /api/admin/consulting/bookings. Frontend Playwright: admin sidebar has 'Onaylı Danışmanlıklar' entry (visible in /yonetim screenshot); /yonetim/danismanlik-onay renders the seeded approved booking card (approved-booking-<id>) with meet-input-<id> and save-meet-<id>; filling https://meet.google.com/aaa-bbbb-ccc and clicking save shows toast 'Google Meet linki kaydedildi ve öğrenciye bildirildi' and the open-meet-<id> button renders with the exact href. /yonetim/danismanlik 'Randevu Talepleri' section excludes approved bookings (booking id count = 0). Student panel (/panel Bire Bir Danışmanlık tab) shows the header 'Görüşmeler Google Meet üzerinden yapılır.' and a green consulting-meet-<id> button labeled 'Google Meet\'e Katıl' pointing to the saved meet link.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_consulting._available_credits() now counts granted = (enrollments with source!='free' AND course_id!='') + (orders with kind='consulting' AND status='paid'). The consulting-paid order alone counts as a credit, which is correct per the intended semantics — a purchased 1-hour consulting session IS one credit. Confirmed in test_mark_paid_group_and_consulting_do_not_grant_consulting_credit where consulting mark-paid grants exactly +1 and group mark-paid grants 0.

routes_admin.mark_paid branch for kind='consulting' does nothing besides marking the order paid — no email is sent to the student for a paid consulting order. Consider adding a schedule_email('purchase' or a dedicated 'consulting_purchased') so students receive confirmation. Non-blocking.

AdminApprovedConsulting sends meet_link untrimmed on the server side (routes_consulting.admin_set_meet strips it — good). Client should still validate that the URL starts with https://meet.google.com/ to avoid accidental phishing links. Optional.

routes_consulting.respond_proposal 'accept' path re-checks conflicts but does not push a notification about the newly approved booking to admin except via push_notification('consulting_request', ...). Consider a distinct notification type so admin dashboard can highlight new approvals differently. Non-blocking.

ConsultingPanel.jsx respond() for a 'decline' response toasts 'Öneri reddedildi' but the backend actually cancels the booking (status='cancelled'). Wording is OK for the student but might confuse — booking disappears from active list on refresh. Non-blocking.

Requires MONGO_URL and DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env plus REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Nav route /yonetim/danismanlik-onay is protected by admin auth. PayTR remains unconfigured (503 on purchase). Email 'Resend' send is a no-op in preview; the schedule_email call is treated as success.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verification pass, no bugs found. The prior bug (mark-paid granting spurious consulting credits for group/consulting orders) is confirmed fixed by the branching in routes_admin.mark_paid and the course_id!='' filter in routes_consulting._available_credits.
